pattern: proxy finish LIGHT (proxy_finish.py stage_light + proxy_finish_light.py): the frozen Pixal3D sheet proxy kept as generated (geometry + texture), made watertight, decimated, baked, optionally reposed with bones

refloor.why: the floor at the drill-tail TIP (the worm stands on its pointed tail as drawn; proxy tip at x -0.05 y -0.27 z 0), then x(6.69 / 6.637) to the sheet front height

light.uv_fix_why: at the default 66 deg the decimated drill rings fold inside their UV islands (1.6% of texels shared by 2 faces, 305 of the 724 overlapping faces in z 2-3): sand from one face overwrote the drill bands; only the overlapping faces are re-unwrapped (a global 40 deg unwrap fixed it but shattered the atlas to ~10% texel use)
light.ao_fill_why: AO texels under 0.04 are bake origins inside the proxy soup (1.1% of the AO map after the UV repair: black streaks where the arm stalks meet the neck): refilled from valid neighbours

dense.why: head / mouth: the teeth ring and the rim

chains.name: drill_fore
chains.why: the proxy's FORE drill arm per side (L/R averaged: tip y -1.17 on +x, -0.73 on -x)

chains.name: drill_aft
chains.why: the proxy's AFT drill arm per side: Pixal3D read the sheet side view's two offset drills as a fore + aft pair per shoulder (4 arms; the front / back views draw 2)

units: sheet units: 1 unit = 100 px of the reference sheet; floor z = 0

refloor.rule: sheet_proxy put the floor at the lowest point (a tail curl): the feet hung z0 above it; floor moved to the feet, then scaled to the sheet front height

solid.rule: LIGHT: watertight remesh only (no smoothing / straighten / symmetrise / cuts); the surface sits min_half_thickness x step = 0.0112 u outside the proxy

colour.mode: light: the proxy texture as generated

high.rule: marching tets of the whole remesh grid (no mirror)

low.method: collapse decimation: uniform to 300000, then 18000 with the dense boxes calibrated

dense.rule: dense boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1) in the collapse decimation; the factor bisected until the boxes hold density x the rest's triangles per area

uv_fix_overlap.rule: faces in overlapping UV (folds inside a 66 deg island) re-unwrapped alone at angle_deg, the rest kept; opt-in light.uv_fix_overlap

ao_fill.rule: AO < below = a bake origin inside the proxy soup: refilled from the covered valid 3x3 neighbours ring by ring (opt-in light.ao_fill_below)

bake.source: the proxy mesh itself (not the remesh)

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

floor.rule: stage 1 floored the FEET at z 0; the centring puts the lowest point at 0

facing.rule: shell centroid -> the front-most midline point of the shell (proxy finish default)

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)
